reuse.when: Exactly one domain covers the decision and requested mode with no material contract gap.
reuse.return: One exact orchestration ref, rationale, rejected alternatives and actual gaps.

compose.when: At least two supported domains contribute necessary distinct work that cannot be covered faithfully by one domain.
compose.condition: No unresolved contract conflicts. Every selected domain must support the requested execution mode; planning-only domains cannot be laundered into report mode by composition.
compose.return: Exact selected refs and the installed composition schema, including handoff boundaries and review responsibility.

candidate.when: No existing orchestration fits, but a bounded new capability design can be proposed from available components.
candidate.return: Proposed contract, development cases, capability gaps and evaluation requirements.
candidate.boundary: Candidate work does not certify itself, change protected criteria or enter a pinned release silently.

clarify.when: A material ambiguity in the human mandate prevents selecting a useful domain or setting its perimeter.
clarify.return: Smallest decision-relevant missing question plus independent work that remains possible; preserve existing mandate until clarified.

capability-gap.when: The decision is clear but required evidence, methods, tools, independent review or execution support is unavailable.
capability-gap.return: Precise missing prerequisite, affected conclusion, feasible bounded deliverable and restoration condition.
capability-gap.boundary: Do not relabel an unsupported execution as planning and claim the original request completed.

modes.report: Requires selected orchestration execution support and all current release gates; a complete instruction contract is not production verification.
modes.development: Tests or develops candidate components using DEVELOPMENT data without making professional report claims.
modes.experiment: Uses engine-authorized comparison protocols and criteria; does not access protected answers.

common_invalid_selections: Selecting by report title keywords alone
Selecting DCF plus comps before issuer evidence
Composing domains with different dates/currency/perimeter and ignoring conflict
Using latest instead of an exact installed ref
Choosing a weaker evaluation profile because a stricter result failed
wire_authority: Use installed meta.schema.json and composition.schema.json; actions and modes here explain decisions, not alternate schemas.
